measures.name: AW Detail Context
measures.expression: VAR m=SELECTEDVALUE(DimDate[YearMonth],"All months") VAR g=IF(ISFILTERED(DimSalesTerritory[SalesTerritoryGroup]),CONCATENATEX(VALUES(DimSalesTerritory[SalesTerritoryGroup]),DimSalesTerritory[SalesTerritoryGroup],", "),"All groups") VAR c=IF(ISFILTERED(DimSalesTerritory[SalesTerritoryCountry]),CONCATENATEX(VALUES(DimSalesTerritory[SalesTerritoryCountry]),DimSalesTerritory[SalesTerritoryCountry],", "),"All countries") VAR p=IF(ISFILTERED(DimProductCategory[EnglishProductCategoryName]),CONCATENATEX(VALUES(DimProductCategory[EnglishProductCategoryName]),DimProductCategory[EnglishProductCategoryName],", "),"All categories") RETURN m & "  ·  " & g & "  ·  " & c & "  ·  " & p
measures.description: Presentation only; reuses shared business measures without modifying the semantic model.

measures.name: AW Country Title
measures.expression: IF(ISBLANK([Total Sales]),"No data for the current filters","Where · Country — click to filter; right-click to drill through")
measures.description: Presentation only; reuses shared business measures without modifying the semantic model.

measures.name: AW Category Title

measures.description: Presentation only; reuses shared business measures without modifying the semantic model.

measures.name: AW Trend Title
measures.expression: VAR hi=[Source Last Date] VAR lo=EDATE(DATE(YEAR(hi),MONTH(hi),1),-11) VAR n=CALCULATE([Order Lines],FILTER(ALL(DimDate),DimDate[FullDateAlternateKey]>=lo && DimDate[FullDateAlternateKey]<=EOMONTH(hi,0))) VAR coverage=CALCULATE([Partial Month Text],REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),TREATAS({FORMAT(hi,"yyyy-MM")},DimDate[YearMonth])) RETURN "12-month trend · "&FORMAT(lo,"MMM yyyy")&"–"&FORMAT(hi,"MMM yyyy")&IF(COALESCE(n,0)=0," · No data for the current filters — clear Where/What or Reset","")&IF(NOT ISBLANK(coverage)," · "&coverage,"")
measures.description: Presentation only; reuses shared business measures without modifying the semantic model.

measures.name: AW Detail Title
